steps.hint: Click Cass, then left-click near the fire to walk there (double-click to run).
Click Cass, then left-click the zombie to attack it with the knife. It costs no ammo.
steps.retry: Use the knife: click Cass, then left-click the new zombie.

steps.hint: Eli is at the edge of the woods. Click Eli, press {weapon1} for the Gun, then left-click the zombie. Every shot uses one round.
steps.retry: Shoot it: click Eli, press {weapon1} for the Gun, then left-click the new zombie.

steps.hint: Click a survivor, press {hold}, then click toward the woods where it comes from. A survivor on Hold strikes whatever walks up inside the green cone.
steps.retry: Hold the line: click a survivor, press {hold}, then click toward the new zombie.
